title: Definitions Entry — The Charge Reading Stretch on a Statement, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Definitions Entry — The Charge Reading Stretch on a Statement, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**The stretch of whole calendar months the charge reading runs over**, when a billing cycle closes on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan, is read in one of three ways.

1. Where a payment on the plan has been sent back unpaid in the whole month ending on the handling date, the charges read are those booked in that single whole month.
2. Where the plan has been billing for fewer whole calendar months than the term's repeat window, the charges read are those booked since the plan began billing.
3. In every other case, the charges read are those booked in the **2** whole months ending on the handling date.

The first reading governs first: a return in the month just ending narrows the stretch to that one month however long the plan has been billing.

## The repeat window by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repeat window, rolling whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

The repeat window stands at 6 whole calendar months on every promotional term.

## Readings (hypothetical)

| The plan | The stretch |
|---|---|
| Billing for 14 whole calendar months, a payment sent back unpaid in the month just ending | The single whole month ending on the handling date |
| Billing for 3 whole calendar months, no return in that month | Back to the date the plan began billing, that is 3 whole months |
| Billing for 14 whole calendar months, no return in that month | The 2 whole months ending on the handling date |
